Wednesday, August 12, 2026 - 16:00

Low Pressure Area Condition

    Issued at 16:00 hours M.S.T on 12-8-2026

According to the observations at 15:30 hrs MST today, the low pressure area over the North Bay of Bengal and off West Bengal, India - Bangladesh coasts still persists. It is likely to become a Well Marked Low Pressure Area during next 12 hrs and move Northwestwards and intensify into a Depression and across West Bengal, India and adjoining Bangladesh coasts during next 36 hrs.
